critic_findings.message: The conventions create a 'Keys' mix bus only 'if there are multiple keyboards', but this show has only one keyboard (the Keys L/R stereo pair is a single instrument); the plan created the Keys bus anyway and routed the Keys channel only to it instead of direct to Main.

TRAX is patched from a Line input on the AES50 stage box, which has a physical head-amp/gain stage (unlike USB/card/player sources); conventions say to set gain to 20dB on each channel unless overridden, and the DI-only override in instructions doesn't apply here, yet gain_db was left null.
The Speech mute group is declared unconditionally in the conventions but no speech-category channel exists in this show, so it is declared but unused. -- quoting "Speech: All speech channels"

The stereo pairing of Keys L/R is directly stated by the conventions' rule for sequential L/R inputs, not something the model had to infer from general practice; marking it 'inferred' with a generic basis understates that the conventions already settled it.
